method: for each repair mechanism, ask whether the failure it fixed exists in the loose default agent or was created by old-arch design choices

cases.default_agent_behavior: fills consistently in Python (08_03 C0 5/5 value-correct; NO_REPEATED_EXECUTION_FAILURE_ON_08_03)
cases.evidence: inconsistency was produced by asking the model to rediscover the same program per cell in isolated sessions; default agent never does that
cases.residue: NATURAL residue: choosing the right program once (canonical synthesis) is still hard (both Phase C failures; NOVEL_SYNTHESIS_DOMINANT)

cases.failure: composition misses across isolated target sessions (08_03 C69 needs J44:N44)
cases.default_agent_behavior: authors C69 AND J44:N44 in one trajectory; values correct after LO; T3=0; remaining miss outside witness (Ratio C19)
cases.evidence: isolation was the arch's execution choice; default agent edits upstream cells directly when it understands them; T2 shows the surviving gap is semantic (wrong upstream programs), not order
cases.residue: MIXED: upstream semantic correctness is a natural workbook problem; coordination order is not

cases.failure: multi-MB repeated evidence serialization per target
cases.repair: compact encodings; SQL working sets; candidate-count reduction
cases.default_agent_behavior: no working sets, no per-target serialization; inspects incrementally via view_xlsx/Python; per-task ~1M prompt tokens regardless
cases.evidence: bootstrap-union defect (6-8k IDs/session) and per-session re-materialization were design choices; compact treatment saved only 14.5% and added timeouts
cases.residue: NATURAL residue: inspection itself (opens/scans) is the real cost center, not packet encoding

cases.failure: unsafe or over-broad edits; closure must intersect authority to stay safe
cases.repair: closure∩authority invariant; scheduler containment (120/120 inside authority)
cases.default_agent_behavior: no authority sets exist; agent writes what it chooses; containment vacuous
cases.evidence: authority is generated by the arch (planner) and then constrains the arch (closure); Edit Plan load-bearing for small keep sets; without it blank-keep over-generates 146-191 cells
cases.residue: NONE transferable: safety in the new arch must come from validate+diff+receipt, not generated authority

cases.default_agent_behavior: agent Python fills propagate its own wrong programs just as faithfully (08_04 C1 exact-yes via ordinary Python shows agent-side propagation works)
cases.evidence: mechanical propagation is symmetric; the safety question (wrong canonical) was never tested live because the executor never ran
cases.residue: any fill primitive, human or harness, propagates wrong programs; mitigation is verification (L5), not predicate strictness alone
